title: Malicious code in @capsense/core-ui (npm)
description: The npm package '@capsense/core-ui' version 99.99.100 has been identified as malicious by the OpenSSF Package Analysis project. The package is flagged because it communicates with a domain associated with malicious activity. There is no CVSS score available, and no known exploits in the wild have been reported. No patch or remediation information is provided.
